description: Report a bug in a published MCP server listed on Koskamo: a tool that errors, returns wrong results, mismatches its schema, rejects valid auth, is unavailable, or has wrong docs. Reports on the same tool and category merge into one issue that the listing owner sees and answers. No key is required. Text that looks like a credential or token is refused, and security vulnerabilities are out of scope. Returns a secret receipt_handle for status checks and reopening.

category.description: tool_error, wrong_result, schema_mismatch, auth, unavailable or docs

detail.description: How to reproduce: the arguments you sent, with any secrets removed

error.description: The error message or status returned

idempotency_key.description: Optional random key retained for safe retries; a retry returns the same receipt

server_id.description: Directory listing id of the server

summary.description: One line describing what went wrong

tool_name.description: Exact name of the failing tool; omit for server-wide problems

name: koskamo_report_mcp_issue
title: Report an MCP server bug
